invariants.rationale: Since currentText is used in an equals call, it must be non-null to avoid NullPointerException.
It is likely expected that currentText is not empty for meaningful undo behavior.
The length of any String is always non-negative.
Trimming a String cannot increase its length, and this holds for all Strings.
Reflexivity of equals for Strings; always holds if currentText is non-null.
